About this item

  • LONG LASTING BATTERY LIFE: Bask in up to 80 hours of electrifying gameplay with backlighting on or p ush your endurance up to 1500 hours with backlighting off.
  • TRI- MODE CONNECTIVITY: Switch between dual wireless connectivity; A smooth 2.4GHz wireless connection and a Bluetooth, swiftly switching among three devices, or simply connect via usb cable. Your connectivity, your call.
  • COPIOUS CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS: With swappable toolless top plates, badges, and rotary knobs, you’ll have a wealth of ways to show off your own individual style. Rise up!
  • GASKET MOUNTED KEYBOARD: The Alloy Rise 75 Wireless is gasket mounted, pairing that feature with smooth, easy-actuating HyperX Linear Switches to make your typing an even more comfortable experience.
  • HOT- SWAPPABLE KEYBOARD: Take keyboard personalization even further with the ability to hot-swap your key switches of choice into the board.
  • SMART AMBIENT LIGHT SENSOR: Game at any time seamlessly with the ambient light sensor, dynamically adjusting the backlighting of your RGB to your environmental lighting conditions. Just tweak your preferences in NGENUITY and you’re set!
  • STABILITY AND RELIABILITY: HyperX Linear Switches have a half-wall POM stem for better stability of the preinstalled HyperX PBT Keycaps5. They're also factory lubed for smooth actuation and rated for up to 80 million keypresses.
  • CONVENIENT VOLUME CONTROL: Take control of your audio entertainment with a dedicated rotary knob to adjust or mute the volume.

From the manufacturer

Up to 1500 hours of battery life

Bask in up to 80 hours of electrifying gameplay with backlighting on or push your endurance up to 1500 hours with backlighting off.

Previous page

  1. Tri-mode connectivity

    Select a smooth 2.4GHz wireless connection or switch between up to 3 devices with Bluetooth. Need a wired option? Simply connect via USB-C cable. Your connectivity, your call.

  2. Copious customization options

    With swappable toolless top plates, badges, and rotary knobs, you’ll have a wealth of ways to show off your own individual style. Rise up!

  3. Gasket mounted keyboard

    This keyboard is gasket mounted, pairing that feature with smooth, easy-actuating HyperX Linear Switches to make your typing an even more comfortable experience.

Next page

Hot-swappable key switches

Take keyboard personalization even further with the ability to hot-swap your key switches of choice into the board.

Ambient light sensor

The game at any time seamlessly with the ambient light sensor, dynamically adjusting the backlighting of your RGB to your environmental lighting conditions. Just tweak your preferences in NGENUITY and you’re set!

Superior keypress stability and reliability

HyperX Linear Switches have a half-wall POM stem for better stability of the preinstalled HyperX PBT Keycaps. They're also factory-lubed for smooth actuation and rated for up to 80 million keypresses.

Convenient volume control

Take control of your audio entertainment with a dedicated rotary knob to adjust or mute the volume.

What's in the box?

  • keyboard
  • USB-C to USB-A cable
  • wireless dongle
  • keycap/switch puller
  • QSG

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      Immediately after falling in love with the wired HyperX keyboard, I wanted a wireless keyboard for home use to use my wired keyboard at work. This keyboard is a good quality metal keyboard with tons of customization.

      I paired it with the HyperX pudding keycaps in white to match my aesthetics. The RGB lighting is customizable with Windows, the HP software that you downloaded separately, and with HP Omen lighting.

      The keyboard functions wirelessly by USB dongle or Bluetooth. The keyboard shortcuts to show battery life and adjust brightness are nice.

      I like that the switches can be swapped out along with the face plate for ultimate customized layouts. The keyboard is not too heavy but has some weight to it from its metal body. The sound is clicky despite the red switches being linear and quieter. The feel is nice but I do find my fingers sliding over the keys a little too easily at times when typing fast. Nonetheless, this is an excellent keyboard for the money but I would advise someone to buy it on sell and not at full price.
      My main gripe is that the function and side keys having double function with the Fn key do not have a compatible analog if you want to swap all the keycaps and still know what that key actually does, which is why I did not change the keycaps to the keys below the volume knob. The keyboard is held together magnetically to hold the face plate to the body and capper by the metal side badge piece. Be careful when lifting this keyboard or the face plate will separate.

      So far the battery life is nice and the keyboard goes to sleep if not used after a while.
